title: How the Swiss city of Lugano is trying to reinvent itself as a crypto hub to boost its economy by launching its own token LVGA, partnering with Tether, and more (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: How the Swiss city of Lugano is trying to reinvent itself as a crypto hub to boost its economy by launching its own token LVGA, partnering with Tether, and more — Lugano bets digital assets and a joint venture with the stablecoin giant can boost its economy, but some warn of dangers
